id.description: Slug. Must equal the folder name under sheets/.

category.description: Broad bucket, e.g. IDE, Shell, VCS, OS, Language, DevOps.

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Searchable and used as Finder tags.

aliases.description: Other names people search by (nicknames, abbreviations, misspellings).

image.description: Image file in the same folder (png/jpg/pdf).

source.description: Where the content came from / which version it is valid for.

keys.description: Alternative chords, e.g. ["cmd+shift+o"]. Modifiers: ctrl opt shift cmd. Keys: letters, f1-f12, enter, backspace, space, up, down, left, right, tab, esc, click, or a symbol.

check.description: Set when the source image disagrees with the official default; explains the doubt.

command.description: Shell/CLI command, for sheets that are not about key chords (e.g. git). Searchable.

color.description: CSS color for the card in the rendered image (tools/render_sheet.py).

icon.description: Emoji shown in the card header of the rendered image.

render.description: Options for tools/render_sheet.py (subtitle, tagline, logo, layout e.g. [2,3,3], footer_tips, footer_note, footer_sign).
